candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(0) so withdrawAll sends 0 instead of full balance.
Remove requirement check so onlyOwner modifier no longer restricts access (allows anyone to call withdrawAll).
Changed withdraw to send funds to a fixed different address (owner) instead of msg.sender, altering post-call balance observed by caller.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can withdraw funds, changing who observes balance changes after withdraw.
Modified onlyOwner to check for the zero address instead of the owner, effectively disabling owner protection and allowing non-owner to pass the check, changing who can call withdraw.
Changed withdraw to call transfer with a different value (0) regardless of input, so state change observable by caller differs.
Change the low-level call to instead always revert when call fails by using require(_s) and remove the unused bytes variable.
Replace external call with a direct transfer to the target, which uses transfer semantics and changes gas/behavior on failure.
Remove the onlyOwner check by replacing the modifier body to allow any caller (require false removed to allow all).
